hookRows.body_you: Love and what feels good run at full signal: taste sharpens, small pleasures land bigger, wanting stops feeling like a liability. Something lovely, unjustified, is exactly the point right now.
hookRows.body_they: Their taste sharpens and small pleasures land bigger. Something lovely and unjustified is exactly the point for them right now.
hookRows.notes: Target-specific soft-contact effect: transiting venus on natal venus.

hookRows.body_you: Effort and pleasure cooperate: the plan you initiate turns out to be the fun one. Make the move, book the thing, cook the meal; wanting works when you act on it.
hookRows.body_they: Plans they initiate turn out to be the fun ones. Their wanting works best in motion.
hookRows.notes: Target-specific soft-contact effect: transiting venus on natal mars.

hookRows.body_you: Generosity comes back with interest: the invitation multiplies, the kindness gets quoted, the treat turns into an occasion. Say yes to the social thing you would normally ration.
hookRows.body_they: Their generosity comes back with interest: invitations multiply, kindness gets quoted. Social yeses they would normally ration pay off.
hookRows.notes: Target-specific soft-contact effect: transiting venus on natal jupiter.

hookRows.body_you: Affection and reliability shake hands: the reliable person looks newly attractive, and the long relationship shows its craftsmanship. Choose the durable pleasure; this window has excellent taste in foundations.
hookRows.body_they: The reliable person looks newly attractive to them, and the long relationship shows its craftsmanship. Their taste in foundations is excellent this window.
hookRows.notes: Target-specific soft-contact effect: transiting venus on natal saturn.

hookRows.body_you: Taste benefits from the pattern break: the unplanned date, the genre you never buy, the person outside the type. Let the algorithm take the week off; the surprises are curated well.
hookRows.body_they: The unplanned date and the outside-the-type person suit them now. The surprises are curated well this week.
hookRows.notes: Target-specific soft-contact effect: transiting venus on natal uranus.

hookRows.body_you: Love gets its atmosphere back: the ordinary evening turns cinematic, the familiar face catches new light. Romance the thing you already have; enchantment is cheap this window.
hookRows.body_they: Ordinary evenings turn cinematic for them and familiar faces catch new light. Enchantment is cheap for them this window.
hookRows.notes: Target-specific soft-contact effect: transiting venus on natal neptune.

hookRows.body_you: Attraction gains depth clearance: the conversation goes past the pleasantries on its own, and closeness that seemed risky starts feeling like ground. Accept the deeper invitation; it is structural.
hookRows.body_they: Their conversations go past pleasantries on their own, and risky-seeming closeness starts feeling like ground. The deeper invitation is structural.
hookRows.notes: Target-specific soft-contact effect: transiting venus on natal pluto.

hookRows.body_you: The unloved-feeling part gets direct evidence to the contrary, and this time it files correctly. Let the kindness land all the way; receipts against the old story are the medicine.
hookRows.body_they: The part of them that felt unlovable gets direct evidence to the contrary, and this time it files correctly. Kindness landing all the way is the medicine.
hookRows.notes: Target-specific soft-contact effect: transiting venus on natal chiron.

hookRows.body_you: What you enjoy and where you are headed overlap for once: the growth tastes good, the new direction gains a social life. Follow the pleasant pull; it is pointing the right way this week.
hookRows.body_they: Their growth tastes good this week and the new direction gains a social life. The pleasant pull points the right way.
hookRows.notes: Target-specific soft-contact effect: transiting venus on natal north-node.

hookRows.body_you: The past offers its good china: the old friend resurfaces warm, the former chapter sends a fond dividend with no strings visible or hidden. Enjoy the visit as a visit.
hookRows.body_they: Old friends resurface warm for them, with no strings visible or hidden. The visit enjoyed as a visit is exactly right.
hookRows.notes: Target-specific soft-contact effect: transiting venus on natal south-node.

hookRows.body_you: The real want turns out to be charming: the honest preference delights instead of scandalizing. Order what you actually want, in restaurants and elsewhere; watch the room enjoy it.
hookRows.body_they: Their honest preference delights instead of scandalizing. What they actually want, ordered plainly, charms the room.
hookRows.notes: Target-specific soft-contact effect: transiting venus on natal lilith.

hookRows.body_you: You photograph well in every sense: the presence lands warm, the style choices work, people leave conversations liking you and unsure exactly why. Schedule the first dates and first meetings here.
hookRows.body_they: Their presence lands warm and people leave conversations liking them, unsure exactly why. First dates and first meetings booked now start ahead.
hookRows.notes: Target-specific soft-contact effect: transiting venus on natal ascendant.

hookRows.body_you: Charm reaches the career: the interview turns into a conversation, the client warms, the work gets called a pleasure to receive. Make the professional ask while the reception is this good.
hookRows.body_they: Their interviews turn into conversations and clients warm. Professional asks made while the reception is this good tend to land.
hookRows.notes: Target-specific soft-contact effect: transiting venus on natal midheaven.

hookRows.body_you: The partnership remembers why: the shared joke revives, the affection gets specific again, the division of labor briefly feels like teamwork. Mark the occasion somehow; noted good spells extend themselves.
hookRows.body_they: Their partnership remembers why: the shared joke revives, affection gets specific. Good spells noted out loud extend themselves.
hookRows.notes: Target-specific soft-contact effect: transiting venus on natal descendant.

hookRows.body_you: Home turns hospitable: the space wants guests, the family conversation warms, the domestic project beautifies instead of burdening. Host the meal; the room is on your side.
hookRows.body_they: Their home turns hospitable: the space wants guests, the family conversation warms. Meals hosted now land warm.
hookRows.notes: Target-specific soft-contact effect: transiting venus on natal imum-coeli.

hookRows.body_you: Mercury runs retrograde during part of this crossing, so the weeks double back on themselves: messages resurface, plans revise, and the same conversation comes around twice. The second pass is the editing pass; revise rather than redo, and reconfirm anything with a date on it.
hookRows.body_they: Mercury runs retrograde during part of this crossing, so their weeks double back: messages resurface, plans revise, and the same conversation comes around twice. The second pass is the editing pass for them, and anything with a date on it deserves a reconfirm.
hookRows.note: Retrograde overlay for the two-layer house card; renders as an extra part when isRetrograde is passed. Revise-not-redo framing.

hookRows.body_you: Venus runs retrograde during part of this crossing, so the window reviews instead of previews: old names resurface, tastes get second-guessed, and what you valued last year comes up for reappraisal. Let the reviews finish before making the purchases and promises permanent.
hookRows.body_they: Venus runs retrograde during part of this crossing, so the window reviews instead of previews for them: old names resurface, tastes get second-guessed, and what they valued last year comes up for reappraisal. The purchases and promises hold better made after the reviews finish.
hookRows.note: Retrograde overlay for the two-layer house card; renders as an extra part when isRetrograde is passed. Revise-not-redo framing.

hookRows.body_you: Mars runs retrograde during part of this crossing, so the drive turns inward and doubles back: stalled projects resurface, old frustrations ask to be finished properly, and force works better revised than repeated. Aim the energy at completing what is already open.
hookRows.body_they: Mars runs retrograde during part of this crossing, so their drive turns inward and doubles back: stalled projects resurface, old frustrations ask to be finished properly, and force works better revised than repeated. The energy pays best aimed at what is already open.
hookRows.note: Retrograde overlay for the two-layer house card; renders as an extra part when isRetrograde is passed. Revise-not-redo framing.

hookRows.body_you: You've been running on autopilot through a version of yourself that needs updating. The Sun's move into Leo hands everyone a month of warm, expressive, spotlight-seeking light to work with. Use it on the part of your life that has been needing your attention.
hookRows.body_they: You've been running on autopilot through a version of yourself that needs updating. The Sun's move into Leo hands everyone a month of warm, expressive, spotlight-seeking light to work with. Use it on the part of your life that has been needing your attention.
hookRows.notes: Voice-first placement hook. Pair-authored copy overrides the generic planet hook.

hookRows.body_you: For about a month, warmth, nerve, and the urge to make something with our name on it run hotter. We want to be looked at doing the thing we are proud of, not just to have done it. Confidence comes cleanest when it has something generous to point at: a project, a person, or a cause worth making visible.
hookRows.body_they: For about a month, warmth, nerve, and the urge to make something with our name on it run hotter. We want to be looked at doing the thing we are proud of, not just to have done it. Confidence comes cleanest when it has something generous to point at: a project, a person, or a cause worth making visible.
hookRows.notes: Voice-first lived-expression slot.

hookRows.body_you: The catch is that Leo measures by applause, and applause is a fickle ruler. The same heat that makes us bold can make us touchy about credit, quick to put on a show, and slow to stay when somebody else has the spotlight. Build from the inside out and people notice. Chase the clout directly and you'll just watch it land on somebody else.
hookRows.body_they: The catch is that Leo measures by applause, and applause is a fickle ruler. The same heat that makes us bold can make us touchy about credit, quick to put on a show, and slow to stay when somebody else has the spotlight. Build from the inside out and people notice. Chase the clout directly and you'll just watch it land on somebody else.
hookRows.notes: Voice-first shadow-and-turn slot.

hookRows.body_you: Pressure rises and we tighten up. For about two and a half days, everything gets weighed against the plan. The Moon gets serious here, and so do we.
hookRows.body_they: Pressure rises and we tighten up. For about two and a half days, everything gets weighed against the plan. The Moon gets serious here, and so do we.
hookRows.notes: Voice-first placement hook, restored from the stronger prior card.

hookRows.body_you: Feelings get translated into tasks: make the list, keep the promise, handle the thing before it becomes a problem. Competence feels comforting, but it can also become armor. We stay busy enough to avoid admitting that something hurts.
hookRows.body_they: Feelings get translated into tasks: make the list, keep the promise, handle the thing before it becomes a problem. Competence feels comforting, but it can also become armor. We stay busy enough to avoid admitting that something hurts.
hookRows.notes: Voice-first lived-expression slot.

hookRows.body_you: The catch is treating every feeling like a problem to solve. Not everything difficult is a failure, and not everything tender needs a plan. Do what is yours to do, then let yourself be human off the clock.
hookRows.body_they: The catch is treating every feeling like a problem to solve. Not everything difficult is a failure, and not everything tender needs a plan. Do what is yours to do, then let yourself be human off the clock.
hookRows.notes: Voice-first shadow-and-turn slot.

hookRows.body_you: You already know the conversation you have been avoiding. Mercury's move into Cancer changes the voice in the room: thinking and talking turn protective, intuitive, and feeling-led, and words that would not come before may come easier now. Say the thing while the channel is open.
hookRows.body_they: You already know the conversation you have been avoiding. Mercury's move into Cancer changes the voice in the room: thinking and talking turn protective, intuitive, and feeling-led, and words that would not come before may come easier now. Say the thing while the channel is open.
hookRows.notes: Voice-first placement hook, restored from the stronger prior card.

hookRows.body_you: For the next few weeks, memory sits in on every conversation. We hear the tone behind the words, remember how the last version went, and decide what feels true before we can explain why. The right sentence can reach somebody here because it sounds like a person, not a press release.
hookRows.body_they: For the next few weeks, memory sits in on every conversation. We hear the tone behind the words, remember how the last version went, and decide what feels true before we can explain why. The right sentence can reach somebody here because it sounds like a person, not a press release.
hookRows.notes: Voice-first lived-expression slot.

hookRows.body_you: The catch is speaking in hints and resenting people for missing them. Sensitivity can make the message kinder, or it can make the message impossible to find. Say what happened, say what you need, and leave the scavenger hunt out of it.
hookRows.body_they: The catch is speaking in hints and resenting people for missing them. Sensitivity can make the message kinder, or it can make the message impossible to find. Say what happened, say what you need, and leave the scavenger hunt out of it.
hookRows.notes: Voice-first shadow-and-turn slot.

hookRows.body_you: You've been calling it picky, but it is really your taste getting clearer. Venus in Virgo turns attraction practical. Let yourself want what you actually want, not what photographs well.
hookRows.body_they: You've been calling it picky, but it is really your taste getting clearer. Venus in Virgo turns attraction practical. Let yourself want what you actually want, not what photographs well.
hookRows.notes: Voice-first placement hook.

hookRows.body_you: For about four weeks, affection, taste, and money all bend toward the useful: the gesture that actually helps over the grand one, the person who remembers how we take our coffee over the one who performs romance. Venus here reads love as attention, clocking what someone needs before they ask and quietly handling it.
hookRows.body_they: For about four weeks, affection, taste, and money all bend toward the useful: the gesture that actually helps over the grand one, the person who remembers how we take our coffee over the one who performs romance. Venus here reads love as attention, clocking what someone needs before they ask and quietly handling it.
hookRows.notes: Voice-first lived-expression slot.

hookRows.body_you: Push practical love too far and it curdles: help hardens into control, and care shows up as a list of corrections. We start loving people by fixing them, or earning our keep by staying useful until there is nothing left over. Care lands best with no invoice attached. Try to be needed instead of loved and you'll end up neither.

hookRows.notes: Voice-first shadow-and-turn slot.

hookRows.body_you: The collective mood drops below the surface. Small things land harder, silence gets louder, and we start reading for what people are not saying.
hookRows.body_they: The collective mood drops below the surface. Small things land harder, silence gets louder, and we start reading for what people are not saying.
hookRows.notes: Voice-first placement hook.

hookRows.body_you: For about two and a half days, feelings get heavier and more private: less said out loud, more felt in the gut. This is the fastest hand on the clock, a passing tone rather than a chapter. It is sharp while it lasts and mostly gone in a few days.
hookRows.body_they: For about two and a half days, feelings get heavier and more private: less said out loud, more felt in the gut. This is the fastest hand on the clock, a passing tone rather than a chapter. It is sharp while it lasts and mostly gone in a few days.
hookRows.notes: Voice-first lived-expression slot.

hookRows.body_you: The pull is to test the people we love, to poke at a bond to see if it holds, or to go quiet and make them guess. Scorpio feelings want the truth, but they will settle for control when the truth feels too exposed. Say the raw thing and it clears. Hold it in and it leaks out sideways, aimed at whoever is closest.

hookRows.body_you: The old doubt about being allowed to go first gets loud again. Chiron in Aries presses on the right to want things, take up space, and act without attaching a written apology.
hookRows.body_they: The old doubt about being allowed to go first gets loud again. Chiron in Aries presses on the right to want things, take up space, and act without attaching a written apology.
hookRows.notes: Voice-first placement hook.

hookRows.body_you: Chiron sits in a sign for years, so a whole generation carries this tender spot together. We see it in whose anger is allowed, who gets called selfish, and what happens when somebody finally stops asking permission.
hookRows.body_they: Chiron sits in a sign for years, so a whole generation carries this tender spot together. We see it in whose anger is allowed, who gets called selfish, and what happens when somebody finally stops asking permission.

hookRows.body_you: The wound shows up two ways: freezing when it is time to assert, or overcorrecting into aggression to cover the freeze. Both are the same bruise. You don't heal the fear of being too much by staying small. You heal it by taking up room and surviving the discomfort.

hookRows.body_you: Some structures do not reform; they compost. Pluto in Aquarius is taking apart the arrangements that stopped serving anyone and growing something stranger in their place.
hookRows.body_they: Some structures do not reform; they compost. Pluto in Aquarius is taking apart the arrangements that stopped serving anyone and growing something stranger in their place.
hookRows.notes: Voice-first placement hook.

hookRows.body_you: Pluto takes about twenty years to cross a sign, so this is an era, not a mood. In Aquarius it goes to work on power itself: who holds it, who it runs through, and how much of it now lives in networks, machines, and crowds instead of a few hands at the top. The systems we treat as permanent are exactly the ones being quietly rebuilt.

hookRows.body_you: The shadow is the group that swallows the person: control dressed up as progress, the crowd deciding it speaks for everyone. Pluto keeps exposing which shared structures serve the many and which only claim to. You do not get to opt out of an era this size. You only get to decide what you are helping to build inside it.

hookRows.body_you: Leo is the fifth sign, fixed fire ruled by the Sun, and its symbol is the lion. It rules high summer, when the light is at its most generous and everything ripens in the open. The stereotype is the show-off; the older story is the sovereign whose warmth makes other people braver.

hookRows.body_you: As a heart-centered leader, Leo ignites a fire in us that calls for authentic self-expression and creative courage. It naturally gravitates toward the spotlight, not only from ego, but from the sense that our creative, passionate fire deserves to be seen and celebrated. The Sun is at home in Leo, so this comes easily when it has something generous to point at.

hookRows.body_you: Leo season doesn't chase the spotlight. It asks what story you've been telling to hold onto it, and what part of yourself you created or held back to be liked, approved, adored, or accepted. Being visible matters. But watch the temptation to mistake attention for intimacy.

hookRows.body_you: Confidence opens doors hesitation kept locked, and the wins land larger. Just don't let enthusiasm write checks your execution can't cash. Confidence gets you into the room; substance is what keeps you in it.

hookRows.body_you: Aquarius is the eleventh sign, fixed air ruled by Saturn in the old system and Uranus in the modern, and its symbol is the water bearer, pouring something out for everyone. It rules deep winter, when survival depends on the group, and it governs community, invention, and the future. The stereotype is the detached one; the older story is the neighbor who carries what the whole village needs.
